authorization: User requested evaluating the normal-added models on the separate 222-person evaluation set so the paper can report before/after results on one evaluation set.
question: On the 222 people held out from all model development, how do the Stanford-only models and the models trained with LJMU assumed scores compare?
input: Existing final223-frozen features: 222 people, 377 records. No new preprocessing, exclusions or labels.

arms.baseline: Existing Stanford-only predictions already stored in final223-frozen. Not recomputed.
arms.mixed: Normal-added models with the calibration stored at training (Stanford + LJMU training rows).
arms.mixed_stanford_cal: Same normal-added networks. Each member slope and intercept fitted by least squares on that member's Stanford training rows only.

models: Seven paper models: CNN, RF, STT, bilateral STT, CNN ensemble, STT ensemble, CNN-STT fusion. Fusion uses the fixed fold weights in bundle/ensemble.json. RF has no linear calibration, so mixed_stanford_cal does not apply to RF.
aggregation: Windows to record, then calibration, then the fold combination, then the equal mean of five outer-fold outputs. Same as the baseline evaluation.

metrics.mae: Within-person mean over records and sides, then equal mean across people.
metrics.bias: Prediction minus measured GDI, same weighting.
metrics.bands: All, below 50, below 70, 90 or above, 100 or above. Bands use the measured GDI of each record-side observation.
metrics.association: Pearson correlation and regression slope of prediction on measured GDI over record-side observations.

primary_comparison: Fusion overall MAE: mixed_stanford_cal minus baseline.
uncertainty: Paired person bootstrap, 10000 draws, seed 20261106, percentile 95% interval. Exploratory, not adjusted for multiple comparisons, conditional on fitted models.
reporting_rule: Every result is reported whatever its direction. No threshold, setting, weight or calibration is chosen from these results.

validation.checkpoint_hashes: Every checkpoint SHA-256 must match complete.json.
validation.person_separation: No evaluation person may appear in a member's training or validation people.
validation.replay: Each member's raw output on the LIVE inputs must reproduce the saved member-raw outputs.
validation.baseline_check: Stored baseline fusion must reproduce MAE 6.248559 and the stored score table.

limitations: This set was already used for the baseline final evaluation and later post-hoc analyses, so it is held out from training but not unseen by the project.
The normal-added models and both calibrations were fixed before this evaluation; none of them used this set.
Small bands below 50 and 100 or above are descriptive.
